scope: H5 open-arena DCM-control biological origin only
scientific_role: mechanism-definition decision; not parameter fitting, ranking, or promotion evidence

decision.definition: Per-video central physical hole/trail-crossing reference from the frozen measurement reconstruction. In the reconstructed DCM-control geometry this is arena_width_mm/2 and Y_Line-Ymin_Arena.
decision.first_track_position_role: Observation initialization and published Beeline start only; explicitly not the H5 biological search origin.

Poissonnier_2026.evidence: Experiment 1 ants traversed the runway, climbed a toothpick through a hole onto the centre of the A4 platform, and were video tracked on the arena until first border contact.
Poissonnier_2026.interpretation: The central hole is the physical arena-entry/start reference. Xstart/Ystart are later measurement coordinates, not the physical release location.

Bonavita_2026.evidence: Origin-referenced search was discovered by analyzing Lasius niger movement relative to the ant's starting point.
Bonavita_2026.scope_limit: This supports a start-referenced representation but does not justify replacing the physical start in Poissonnier's assay with a later tracking coordinate.

measurement_basis.distinction: first_track_position is an observation-start coordinate; entry_reference is the reconstructed physical hole/trail crossing.
measurement_basis.robustness_reason: A biological origin should not change merely because tracking initialization or first-detected frame changes.

initial_radial_gate_consequence.first_track_origin: R(0)=0 by construction at observation start.
initial_radial_gate_consequence.interpretation: These engineering scales are diagnostic only; they demonstrate that origin choice is mechanically consequential and were not used to select or tune an H5 parameter.

rejected_origin.name: first_tracked_observation_position
reason: It is defined by the observation/tracking process rather than the physical arena-entry event.
It would force r=0 at the first observed frame even though the ant has already moved away from the central hole.
Changing the first detected frame could change the biological origin without changing the ant's actual physical start.
It remains essential as the simulated observation start and published-style Beeline start under the frozen measurement policy.

caveat.unobserved_entry_to_first_track_segment: The simulator begins observation at Xstart/Ystart and does not replay the short unobserved segment from the central hole to the first tracked point. H5 therefore begins the observed simulation with a remembered origin at the central entry reference and a current position already displaced from it.
caveat.temporal_decay_implication: If a later H5 draft introduces time-decay of search drive, the definition of biological time zero and any unobserved pre-tracking delay must be resolved before that decay law can be frozen. This origin decision does not authorize assuming such a delay.
caveat.current_constant_drive_compatibility: The current draft preference for constant search drive over the observed arena traversal does not require estimating the unobserved delay.

next_step: Resolve the remaining H5 biological choices: constant versus decaying drive, direction-only versus free-path modulation, radial-gate form, history parameterization, and null nuisance family.
